quest.title: Adventure Takes Courage!
quest.description: You find a familiar place in Sumeru City...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x3

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Greetings. You both look great today. Are you here to take commissions or deal with other affairs?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Why are you both staring at me? Is there something of significance that you would like to inquire about?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Understood. You seem like a seasoned adventurer already.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Then you must be well acquainted with the Adventurers' Guild's way of operation. Therefore, I won't waste your time going over it.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If you have any questions for the Guild, please feel free to ask me at any time.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Please pitch in with the commissions in Sumeru City. Outstanding adventurers like you will surely be a great help to the people here.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Safe travels, Traveler. Ad astra abyssosque!

choices.text: W—We just want to take commissions...
